title: AIOS AutoResearch v0.2 Live Batch/Run Contract
description: Machine-readable companion to docs/standards/AUTORESEARCH_V02_LIVE_CONTRACT.md (issue #411, parent #409). Every live batch must be describable by one instance of this schema before any external call is made. A missing/null numeric budget field or an authority_status other than 'authorized' fails a live batch closed -- see the accompanying validator in scripts/autoresearch_v02_live_contract_validator.py, which enforces the cross-field rules this schema alone cannot express (JSON Schema conditionals here cover the direct ones; the rest -- e.g. 'authorized requires max_cost_amount > 0' -- are enforced in code, tested, and cited from the contract doc).

execution_mode.description: issue #409's two canonical live-evidence-producing modes. field_observation is intake, not an execution_mode of a batch -- a batch always executes as either a fresh repo_replay run, or a field_reproduction re-run of a previously-observed field trace.

transport_id.description: Free-text but must match a transport documented in docs/evidence/AUTORESEARCH_V02_BASELINE_TRANSPORT_AUDIT_2026-09-03.md's candidate matrix (issue #410) or a later equivalent audit; the validator cross-checks this, the schema alone cannot.

transport_authority_status.description: Whether THIS transport has been explicitly authorized for a live call -- deliberately separate from whether it is merely available/configured (issue #411's own core rule: 'An available/configured credential does not itself authorize a live call').

model_version_or_snapshot.description: 'not_captured' is a legitimate, honest value when the transport (e.g. a chat UI) cannot expose an exact model snapshot identity -- never invent one.

sampling_configuration.description: Whatever sampling controls the transport actually exposes (e.g. {} for a chat UI with none observable). Never fabricate a temperature/top_p value the transport does not actually let you set or observe.

max_input_tokens.description: Integer, or the literal string 'not_captured' when the transport cannot expose it.

max_cost_amount.description: REQUIRED to be a positive number before transport_authority_status/authority_status may be 'authorized' for a usage_billed transport (enforced by the validator, not expressible in JSON Schema alone). null is the correct, honest value before an owner sets it -- never a fabricated default.

redaction_policy_ref.description: Pointer into the contract doc's Privacy and field-trace boundary section, e.g. 'AUTORESEARCH_V02_LIVE_CONTRACT.md#8-privacy-redaction-retention-and-forbidden-input-rules'.

usage_metadata_policy.description: 'estimated_disallowed' is the default and the only policy this contract permits for a missing metric -- an estimate must never be presented as observed (issue #411's own non-acceptance example).

synthetic_evidence_allowed_for.description: The ONLY legitimate uses of hand-authored/synthetic evidence in a v0.2 context -- never a live gate.

authority_status.description: Reuses v0.1's candidate/owner_review_pending vocabulary rather than inventing a new one.
